mainEntity.name: What types of content are best for med spa Answer Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: For med spa Answer Engine Optimization, the best content types are those that directly answer common patient questions. This includes detailed FAQs on your website about specific treatments like Botox, fillers, or laser hair removal, clearly explaining procedures, benefits, and potential side effects. Concise service pages with structured data, blog posts addressing patient concerns, and well-optimized Google Business Profile listings are also crucial. Content should be fact-based, easy to understand, and provide direct, accurate answers to common queries to be favored by answer engines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Detailed FAQs, concise service pages with structured data, blog posts, and optimized Google Business Profiles are best for med spa AEO, providing direct answers to patient questions.
